name: Spring Agent Start Bridge
description: Authenticated HTTP bridge exposing OpenClaw tools to spring-agent-start.

serviceToken.description: Shared internal service token used by spring-agent-start.

gatewayUrl.description: Gateway WebSocket URL used by the public OpenClaw CLI RPC client.

gatewayToken.description: Gateway operator token used for tools.catalog and tools.invoke.

eventSinkUrl.description: Spring Agent Start callback URL used to claim inbound channel messages.

allowInstall.description: Allow the deployment administrator to install npm or ClawHub plugins through the bridge.
